name: proto-default-roots-import-written-from-a-subdirectory
description: With no buf.yaml and no proto.import_paths, the import roots are the target root and the include roots of upstream copies, so an import written from a subdirectory, as a protoc -I proto build compiles it, resolves under no root and fails its file, which publishes nothing and carries an unresolved-import note. Since a schema file that could not be read may use any declaration, every record of the target is published live, and a schema-findings-withheld note names the target root.
